visualCharacteristics.purpose: data-entry form (text inputs, radio/checkbox groups such as 'As proof of purchase/lease, I have enclosed one of the following (select one)', selects, submit) built from a form definition

contentPattern.structure: a link to a sheet / JSON form definition (columns Field, Label, Type, Options, Mandatory, Placeholder, Value, Help, Style), plus optional key/value rows: Action (submission endpoint; defaults to the definition sheet), Confirmation (redirect URL), Message (success text), Error (failure text). Alternatively an inline definition table whose first row is the column header

usage: Use for request/upload and calculator input forms. Supported field types: text, email, tel, number, date, url, password, hidden, file, textarea, select, radio / radio-group, checkbox / checkbox-group, heading, plaintext, submit, button. Options are comma- or newline-separated.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any authored form. Point Action at the real submission service; without one, a sheet-backed definition submits to its own sheet.
